newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares close weak ahead of long weekend.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares close weak ahead of long weekend.

text.p: Italian shares closed much weaker on Thursday as investors took selective profits ahead of a long weekend in which Italians vote in more than 1,100 cities in municipal elections whose outcome could influence the government's fortunes.
The all-share Mibtel index finished 0.83 percent lower at 12,177 while the blue chip Mib30 was 0.91 percent down at 18,120. Traders said that with volumes thin values were easily pushed lower.

Fiat dropped 2.83 percent to 5,429 lire ahead of the release of full consolidated results and dividend details. Brokers said that sentiment appeared to be dampened by fears the company's performance would suffer after a government incentive scheme is phased out at the end of the year.
Stet closed weaker on concerns over the 1.2 trillion the group is paying for a 25 percent stake in Austrian mobile phone operator Mobilkom.
Insurers were well down, notably Sai, closing 2.79 percent lower at 12,575.
